method: DIFFERENT FROM AUTHOR and FROM B's parallel review: (1) Built an independent inventory of d9-exit-contract.v1.5 invariants + six exit classes BEFORE reading TO-1..TO-8, then diffed for losses. directionVerdict.detail: Architecture should bind decisions at decision altitude (invariants, ownership, counterexamples, failure posture). Over-specified wire schemas with author dual-written goldens should not be the sole binding form — that lesson is real (D9/R1 churn; retention v3 vacuity under green checker). Stopping d9 v1.6 / r1 v1.4 churn until architecture is right is prudent.
directionVerdict.rejectAsBinding: v1 extraction + register rebind is not an adequate architectural replacement for D9 or R-1.

methodRuleAltitude.detail: Exit class set is CONSUMER-CUSTODY / public CI compatibility (versioning-policy). That exact compatibility surface can be architectural even when expressed as a closed set schema. 'Not with a schema' is form-based (Error pattern: local form → global rule).
methodRuleAltitude.betterRule: Altitude by blast radius, external custody, ownership, reversibility, change cost. Schema may be the binding form of an architectural public contract; schema is detail when it only implements a prior boundary.
methodRuleAltitude.retentionV4Lesson: retention-tiers.v4 already models good architecture altitude: decisions + RA-* + counterexamples + detailedDesignHandoff without freezing wire fields. Scope correction should require D9/R1 architecture objects of that shape, not weak TO/EC lists.

findings.title: D9 extraction TO-1..TO-8 is too weak to rebind architecture
findings.detail: Independent inventory of v1.5 invariants shows loss of semantic six-class partition, envelope parity, pre-admission constructibility, orphan recovery, exit0≠attestation, tombstone expiry, baseline no-mass-net-new. TO-1..8 alone can be satisfied by a single generic failure class. Confirms B-SC-04 by different method (prior blind D9 work + full invariant list, not only architecture/07 prose).
findings.requiredFix: D9 architecture object (v2) with full semantic partition, retained safety invariants, falsifying counterexamples (retention v4 style), and handoff that future wire contracts must fail those CEs. Demote field/axis spellings only.

findings.title: R-1 extraction erases core boundary and overclaims ambient denial
findings.detail: v1.3 boundary table is architectural; CoreDeps field list is detail. Extraction demoted both. EC-7 absolute ambient authority remains false/vacuous without interface-scoped closure (A1-R1V13-02/03). Confirms B-SC-06/07.
findings.requiredFix: R-1 architecture object retaining inside/outside ownership, effectful provider placement, attempt vs content identity (EC-6 kept), lifetime neutrality as semantic re-entrancy not surface flag absence, narrowed ambient claim, CEs.

findings.title: Rebinding without per-finding disposition launders open reviews
findings.detail: Prior D9/R1 blockers (A1-D9-V15*, B-D9V15*, A1-R1*, B-R1*) are architectural or design-handoff, not 'wire only'. Scope-correction has no resolves map. Register moved to generic SC lines. Confirms B-SC-08.
findings.requiredFix: v2 disposition table for every open finding: architectural | rehomed | detailed-design | superseded. Restore unresolved architectural findings as blockers.

findings.title: Detail-% metric is construct-invalid and was used to ratify six artifacts
findings.detail: No reproducible measurement. knownLimitations admits short invariant can outweigh long schema. whatDoesNotChange still promotes threat/operability/versioning/delivery/resolved-inputs/fact-identity as altitude-ok. That is a global claim from a local unreproduced instrument.
findings.requiredFix: Withdraw % as decision evidence; per-artifact consequence audit only.

findings.title: Corrected method rule is form-based overcorrection
findings.detail: Public exit-class compatibility and fingerprint recipes can be architectural while schema-shaped. Align with versioning custody classes and retention v4 pattern.
findings.requiredFix: Rewrite METHOD.ALTITUDE by consequence/custody/ownership/reversibility/change-cost; allow schema when it IS the public boundary.

findings.title: Demotion without mandatory design handoff
findings.detail: retention-tiers.v4 + A1 handoff amendment require RA-CE tests for future contracts. Scope-correction demotes d9/r1 specs to NON-BINDING without equivalent mandatory inheritance of TO/EC (even incomplete ones) or of omitted safety invariants. Confirms B-SC-10.
findings.requiredFix: Every retained architectural invariant gets ≥1 falsifying CE and a handoff clause like retention A1-RTV4-01.

findings.title: TO-8 / VERSIONING ownership still muddled
findings.detail: Additive-only exit classes are a versioning/public-custody decision. Placing them only under D9 TO-8 without dependsOn VERSIONING recreates hidden dependency (B-SC-05).

findings.title: Cross-doc authority still multipolar after partial prose fixes
findings.detail: architecture/07 now says no accepted binding and scope-correction rejected; 09 still points at d9 v1.5 as candidate binding; 11 inventory still elevates v1.5. Register D9 binding null. Better than triple validator confusion, but incomplete (B-SC-09 residual).
findings.requiredFix: Atomic update of 07/09/11 + register when a real D9 architecture v2 exists; until then one sentence: no binding architecture object.
